text: They're lying to you. What damages the liver isn't fried foods or fats. What damages the liver are three things nobody tells you. First, alcohol. You already know that. Second, refined flours and gluten. Third, sugars. That's the real problem. That's why more than half the population has fatty liver. Because we eat too many flours and too many sugars, not fats, sugars. Now I'm going to show you the four best plants to cleanse the liver. Milk thistle, dandelion, dried bay leaves, and artichoke. Put them all together in 250 milliliters of water. Boil for 10 minutes. Turn off the heat and let it rest for five minutes covered. Drink it hot, one cup in the morning before breakfast and another at night before dinner. Do this for one or two weeks. Milk thistle regenerates liver cells. Dandelion flushes out toxins and accumulated bile. Bay leaf reduces inflammation and cleanses the bloodstream. And artichoke activates bile production, which is what your liver needs to release fat. In just a few days, the bloating goes down, digestion improves, energy goes up, and the belly flattens. Save this video. But I want you to understand something. Your liver doesn't get saturated just from flours and sugar. It gets saturated by how you live. Stress overloads the liver every day. The anger you keep silent is processed directly there. The emotions you swallow keep collapsing it. That's why there are people who quit sugar and flours and still have fatty liver because they clean what goes in but don't calm what saturates it from within. This tea cleanses what's accumulated. But if stress continues, the liver gets loaded again. Write in the comments, clean liver. If you're going to prepare this, and if you want to cleanse your liver from the root, I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to do it.
